projects.title: Project 1: NLP-to-SQL Search Platform (American College Football/Sports Analytics)
bullets: Built backend architecture from scratch for an NLP-to-SQL search platform on team/player statistics, covering prompt engineering, model benchmarking, API testing, and database design.
Extended the platform with a hybrid RAG chatbot for query assistance, Stripe subscription integration, and Redis caching; frontend built in TypeScript.

projects.title: Project 2: CA (Chartered Accountant) Workflow Automation
bullets: Developed an automated system using Playwright to log into user accounts and scrape financial data, storing structured records in PostgreSQL with RBAC-based access control.
Built a data management dashboard with WhatsApp integration for notifications; frontend built in TypeScript.

projects.title: Project 3: Medical ECG Prediction System (In Progress)
bullets: Researched model evaluation techniques to predict ECG waveforms and built a rule-based engine as part of Version 1, for early detection of cardiac shock types/pre-alarm conditions.
Transitioning the rule-based engine to ML-based prediction, using Azure/AWS infrastructure for data storage; frontend built in React.

entries.title: Full Stack Developer
